subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement-spec#worktree-per-implementer
why: Owner rulings 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (C, D, I): Prevents: a spec running in the shared checkout beside other people's edits, and the opposite failure of one worktree per small ticket. Owner ruling 2026-11-06 §I3 limits §D: a worktree only for a significant change, none per small ticket, no parallel implementers. Pending bead: cr-r2pa.2.20.
modification: into `worktree-per-significant-change`: upstream gives every implementer its own worktree and branch; ours gives one worktree to a significant change and none to a small ticket, with implementers run one at a time.
rewording: Create a worktree only for a significant change. A spec's work usually is one, and it runs in one worktree on the integration branch. Tickets inside it get no worktree of their own, and implementers run one at a time.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement-spec#worktree-base-check
why: Owner rulings 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (C, D, I): Prevents: work done on the wrong base, and the worse failure of a reset discarding work that was already in the worktree. Upstream resets unconditionally; a reset is destructive, so `AGENTS.md` Safety and owner ruling 2026-11-06 §I3 keep it behind explicit authority. Pending bead: cr-r2pa.2.20.
modification: into `worktree-base-verify`: upstream resets onto the base when it is wrong; ours preserves the work, stops and reports, and resets only with explicit reset authority.
rewording: Confirm the worktree's base before work starts in it. On a mismatch, keep the worktree's contents, stop and report the expected and actual base; reset only when the request explicitly authorizes a reset.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement-spec#pre-report-tip-merge
why: Owner rulings 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (C, D, I): Prevents: work reported done that no longer applies to the tip it must land on. A merge is a commit, so under `AGENTS.md` Safety and owner ruling 2026-11-06 §I3 it runs only with commit authority and is otherwise reported as due. Pending bead: cr-r2pa.2.20.
rewording: Before reporting done, merge the base's tip into the worktree's branch if the request gives commit authority; without that authority, report that the merge is due.

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/implement-spec#worktree-cleanup
why: Owner rulings 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (C, D, I): Prevents: finished worktrees piling up, and removal of a worktree whose work exists nowhere else. Upstream removes every worktree when the build ends; owner ruling 2026-11-06 §I3 takes the cleanup, and removal is held until the work is safe. Pending bead: cr-r2pa.2.20.
rewording: Remove the worktree only after its work is merged, or preserved and reported.

subject: ours:implement
why: Owner rulings D of 2026-11-05 and I3 of 2026-11-06 (scratchpad/mvp-stack/13/owner-rulings-2026-11-05.md), plan 14a U5. New spec scope for a spec whose tickets exist in Beads with blocking edges: a Scope-selector row and references/spec-run.md, loaded only by that scope. One integration branch; the spec's work in one worktree on it; tickets one at a time from the ready frontier with no worktree each and no parallel implementers; base check that stops with work intact and resets only with explicit reset authority; tip merge of the base before reporting; cleanup once the work is merged or preserved and reported; every commit and merge behind commit authority. On that scope only the worktree replaces task-engine.md's shared-checkout stance. Task scope still runs in the current checkout. Description names the spec case and skips writing tickets (to-tickets). Traits added: dependency-edges, single-integration-branch, worktree-per-significant-change, worktree-base-verify, worktree-cleanup, pre-report-tip-merge.

why: Critic-19d fix. F1: cleanup removes the spec worktree only with authority already held, else keeps it and reports its path and that cleanup is due. F3: a workstream, named-phase or bounded-task request keeps its scope; spec scope is a request to implement a spec as a whole, with workstream-seeded specs sent to Workstream/Phase and a one-epic spec to Spec or Task by significance. F4: the run record (spec and epic ids, base branch and starting SHA, integration branch, worktree path) is saved in the implement workspace ledger with a Beads resume pointer, loaded and validated on resume, and every stop reports the worktree path and that pointer. F5: the dependency recipe carries --actor. critic-19d F2: spec-run.md step 8 merges the base's tip into the one integration branch, not the integration branch's tip into each implementer's branch, so it does not deliver pre-report-tip-merge and completion 2026-11-10-renames-splits:107 misattributed it; the coordinator's 19c ruling is withdrawn. The behaviour stays, delivered as pre-report-base-merge. Corrects the attribution under owner ruling I3 of 2026-11-06, with no owner ruling of its own. Its traits list pre-report-base-merge in place of pre-report-tip-merge; withdraws 2026-11-10-renames-splits:107's adoption, whose obligation outlives its supersession, before the adopt into it makes the subject live again.
